title: Image Resizer: honor --filename on first CLI run

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The first offline-archive guarded attempt stopped at its initial Git guard: root exit was zero, but immediate job accounting still reported residual processes. Custody rejected the command and terminated and drained the job; no provision, restore, build or test ran, and the sole lock was released. Saved evidence cannot distinguish launcher overlap from accounting lag. A versioned runner now permits at most two seconds of natural teardown within original deadlines, records process observations, and still rejects persistent residuals even after cleanup. Static checks only supported that preparation. One new serialized attempt is authorized; no result from that attempt is claimed. Full validation and review convergence remain incomplete.
